faq.a: Kartini is associated with the Javanese form كَرْتِينِي, whose core sense is kartini; a javanese female given name.

faq.q: What is the origin of Kartini?
faq.a: Kartini is associated with Javanese. Kartini is a Javanese (Indonesian) female given name, notably borne by Raden Adjeng Kartini.
No — the underlying form is Javanese, not Arabic.
Kartini can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Javanese-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Kartini should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Kartini is a Javanese name, not a Quranic Arabic form.

faq.q: What does Kartini mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Kartini is rendered کرتینی and carries the sense کرتینی (زنانہ نام).

faq.q: What does Kartini mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Kartini is rendered کارتینی and carries the sense کارتینی (نام زنانہ).
A romanized syllable approximation is kar-ti-ni. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Kartini?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Kartini, kartini. Script forms are كَرْتِينِي, کارتینی, کرتيني, کرتینی, कर्तिनी.

faq.q: Is Kartini a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
